# Test coverage by program

Purpose: say honestly which of the programs have their physics checked, and how; the `--help` smoke test is not a physics check and is not counted as one.
Source: `ctest --show-only=json-v1` of the build; 858 tests, 603 programs. Regenerate with `python3 tests/coverage.py <build-dir> --write docs/reference/test-coverage.md`.

| Programs with… | Count | Of |
|---|---:|---:|
| a `physics` test (answer known independently of DiagHam) | 71 | 603 |
| a `crosscheck` test (agrees with another program or algorithm) | 4 | 603 |
| a `regression` test (reproduces a saved spectrum; change detection only) | 11 | 603 |
| **any of the three** | **74** | 603 |
| only a `smoke` test (`--help`) — physics untested | 525 | 603 |
| no test at all | 4 | 603 |
